sources.quote:
or a change
of coating or surface treatment.
Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: The proposal relies on the old Aurelia manual (rev 3, 7.2), which allowed notification only for a coating change. Rev 4 replaces it. Under rev 4, a coating or surface treatment change needs written Aurelia approval (PPAP resubmission) before shipment. It also needs 90 days' notice. The documents do not link BK-330 to a program or customer. I took Aurelia as the customer only because the meeting statement names its manual, so please confirm this. If BK-330 also ships to Nordhavn, CSR-NOR-R2 5.2 would add a separate approval requirement.
